translations.idiomatic: At this summer solstice the Directorate reported noon at the third quarter of wu-zheng; my own measurement of the sun's shadow showed the third quarter of wu-initial plus nine minutes."

sentences.zh: 此時稍有舛錯，恐數十年後所差愈甚。

translations.literal: At this time there is already slight error; I fear that after several decades the discrepancy will grow greater.
translations.idiomatic: The error is already small, but in decades it will grow substantially.

sentences.zh: 猶之錢糧，微塵秒忽，雖屬無幾，而總計之，便積少成多，此事實有證驗，非比書生論說可以虛詞塞責也。

translations.literal: It is like money and grain—dust, minute, second, and fine units seem insignificant, yet totaled they accumulate from little to much; this matter has real verification, not like scholars' discussions that can be answered with empty words."
translations.idiomatic: Like accounts in which tiny sums eventually mount up, this is verified by measurement, not empty scholarly debate."

sentences.zh: 」又諭禮部考取效力算法人員，臨軒親試，取顧琮等四十二人。

translations.literal: " He also ordered the Ministry of Rites to examine persons effective in computational methods, testing them before the throne in person; Gu Cong and forty-two others were selected.
translations.idiomatic: He also ordered the Ministry of Rites to examine candidates skilled in mathematics and test them at court; forty-two including Gu Cong were chosen.

sentences.zh: 五十一年五月，駕幸避暑山莊，徵梅文鼎之孫梅瑴成詣行在。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifty-first year, the emperor visited the Summer Resort and summoned Mei Juecheng, Mei Wending's grandson, to the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Kangxi 51, while at the Summer Resort, the emperor summoned Mei Juecheng, grandson of Mei Wending.

sentences.zh: 先是命蘇州府教授陳厚耀，欽天監五官正何君錫之子何國柱、國宗，官學生明安圖，原任欽天監監副成德，皆扈從侍直，上親臨提命，許其問難如師弟子。

translations.literal: Previously he had ordered Suzhou Prefecture Professor Chen Houyao, He Guozhu and He Guozong sons of Directorate Director He Junxi, official student Ming Antu, and former Deputy Director Cheng De—all to attend in attendance; the emperor personally instructed them, permitting questions and answers like teacher and disciples.
translations.idiomatic: He had already summoned Chen Houyao, the He brothers, Ming Antu, and Cheng De to attend him, instructing them personally and permitting discussion as between teacher and pupils.

sentences.zh: 及徵瑴成至，奏對稱旨，遂與厚耀等同直內廷。

translations.literal: When Juecheng arrived, his answers pleased the emperor, and he served in the inner court together with Houyao and the others.
translations.idiomatic: When Juecheng arrived his answers pleased the emperor, and he joined Chen Houyao and the others in service within the palace.

sentences.zh: 五十二年五月，修律呂、算法諸書，以誠親王允祉、皇十五子允烜、皇十六子允祿充承旨纂修，何國宗、梅瑴成充彙編，陳厚耀、魏廷珍、王蘭生、方苞等充分校。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifty-second year, books on pitch pipes and computational methods were compiled; Prince Cheng Yunzhi, the fifteenth son Yunxuan, and the sixteenth son Yunlu served as chief compilers; He Guozong and Mei Juecheng as collators; Chen Houyao, Wei Tingzhen, Wang Lansheng, Fang Bao, and others as proofreaders.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Kangxi 52 works on pitch pipes and mathematics were compiled under Princes Yunzhi, Yunxuan, and Yunlu, with He Guozong and Mei Juecheng as collators and Chen Houyao, Wei Tingzhen, Wang Lansheng, and Fang Bao as proofreaders.

sentences.zh: 所纂之書，每日進呈，上親加改正焉。

translations.literal: The books compiled were presented daily; the emperor personally corrected them.
translations.idiomatic: Each day's compilation was presented to the emperor, who corrected it in his own hand.

sentences.zh: 五十三年四月，諭誠親王允祉等：「古曆規模甚好，但其數目歲久不合，今修書宜依古曆規模，用今之數目算之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fifty-third year, the emperor instructed Prince Yunzhi and others: "The ancient calendar's structure is very good, but its numbers after long years do not agree; in compiling books, follow the ancient structure but calculate with present numbers."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Kangxi 53 the emperor instructed the compilers: "The ancient calendar's framework is excellent, but its constants have drifted; follow the ancient framework but use modern numbers."

sentences.zh: 」十月，又諭：「北極高度、黃赤距度最為緊要，著於澹寧居後逐日測量。

translations.literal: " In the tenth month, he further instructed: "North polar altitude and ecliptic-equatorial distance are most essential—measure them daily behind the Danning Studio."
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he ordered daily measurement of north polar altitude and ecliptic-equatorial obliquity behind the Danning Studio.

sentences.zh: 」乃製象限儀，儀徑五尺，範銅為之，晝測日度，夜測勾陳帝星。

translations.literal: " A quadrant instrument was then made, five feet in diameter, cast in bronze; by day the sun's degree was measured, by night the Pole Star and Imperial Polar Star.
translations.idiomatic: A quadrant five feet in diameter was cast in bronze to measure the sun by day and the Pole Star and Imperial Star by night.

sentences.zh: 又製中表、正表、倒表各二，俱高四尺，中表測日中心，正表、倒表測日上下邊之景。

translations.literal: Also central, upright, and inverted tables were made, each two each six feet high—the central table measured the sun's center, the upright and inverted tables measured the upper and lower edges of the sun's shadow.
translations.idiomatic: Central, upright, and inverted gnomons six feet high were also made—the central measuring the sun's center, the upright and inverted its upper and lower limbs.

sentences.zh: 惟六表所得日景尾數多參差不合。

translations.literal: Only the six tables' sun-shadow tail numbers had many discrepancies and did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: But the tail figures from the six gnomons showed many discrepancies.

sentences.zh: 海瑴成言：「表高景澹，尾數難真，自古患之。

translations.literal: Mei Juecheng said: "When the table is high the shadow is faint and tail numbers hard to obtain truly—this has been a problem since antiquity."
translations.idiomatic: Mei Juecheng observed: "When the gnomon is tall the shadow grows faint and precise tail readings are difficult—an ancient problem."

sentences.zh: 昔郭守敬為銅表，端挾二龍，舉橫梁至四十尺，因其景虛澹，創為景符以取實影。

translations.literal: In former times Guo Shoujing made a bronze table with two dragons at the end holding a crossbeam up to forty feet; because the shadow was faint and diffuse, he created the shadow-marker to obtain the true image."
translations.idiomatic: Guo Shoujing had raised a bronze gnomon to forty feet with a crossbeam held by dragon figures; because the shadow was diffuse, he invented the shadow-marker to capture the true image."

sentences.zh: 其制以銅葉博二寸，長加博之二，中穿一竅若針芥然，以方木為趺，一端設機軸，令可開闔。

translations.literal: Its form used a copper leaf two inches wide, length twice the width, with a hole in the center like a mustard seed; a square wooden base had a pivot at one end so it could open and close.
translations.idiomatic: It was a copper plate two inches wide and twice as long, pierced by a pinhole; mounted on a pivoted wooden stand.

sentences.zh: 稽其一端，使其針斜倚，北高南下，往來遷就於虛影之中。

translations.literal: One end was set so the needle slanted, north high south low, moving back and forth within the diffuse shadow.
translations.idiomatic: One end was tilted northward so the hole could be adjusted within the diffuse shadow.

sentences.zh: 竅達日光，僅如黍米，隱然見橫梁於其中。

translations.literal: The hole received sunlight only like a millet grain; the crossbeam faintly appeared within it.
translations.idiomatic: Sunlight through the hole, no larger than a millet grain, projected the crossbeam's image.

sentences.zh: 」乃仿元史郭守敬製造景符六，如法用之，影尾數始毫末不爽。

translations.literal: " Six shadow-markers were then made following Guo Shoujing in the Yuan History; used according to method, the shadow tail numbers finally matched without the slightest error.
translations.idiomatic: Six shadow-markers were made on this model, and the tail readings finally agreed to the finest detail.

sentences.zh: 測得申昜春園北極高三十九度五十九分三十秒，比京師觀象台高四分三十秒，黃赤大距二十三度二十九分，比舊測減二分雲。

translations.literal: Measurement yielded north polar altitude at Shenyang Spring Garden of 39 degrees 59 minutes 30 seconds—four minutes 30 seconds higher than the Beijing Observatory; ecliptic-equatorial obliquity 23 degrees 29 minutes—two minutes less than the old measurement.
translations.idiomatic: At Shenyang Spring Garden the north polar altitude was found to be 39°59′30″, 4′30″ higher than Beijing; ecliptic obliquity 23°29′, two minutes less than the previous value.

sentences.zh: 十一月，誠親王允祉等言：「郭守敬造授時術，遣人二十七處分測，故能密合。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Prince Yunzhi and others said: "Guo Shoujing created the Shoushi methods, sending people to twenty-seven places to measure separately, and therefore could achieve close agreement."
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Prince Yunzhi reported: "Guo Shoujing's Shoushi calendar relied on measurements from twenty-seven locations—that is how he achieved such precision."

sentences.zh: 今除申昜春園及觀象台逐日測驗外，如福建、廣東、雲南、四川、陝西、河南、江南、浙江八省，於裏差尤為較著，請遣人逐日測量，得其真數，庶幾東西南北裏差及日天半徑，皆有實據。

translations.literal: Besides daily testing at Shenyang Spring Garden and the Observatory, for the eight provinces Fujian, Guangdong, Yunnan, Sichuan, Shaanxi, Henan, Jiangnan, and Zhejiang where li difference is especially marked, we beg that people be sent to measure daily, obtaining true numbers, so that east-west and north-south li differences and the sun's celestial semidiameter may all have real evidence."
translations.idiomatic: Beyond daily measurements at Shenyang and the Observatory, the eight provinces Fujian, Guangdong, Yunnan, Sichuan, Shaanxi, Henan, Jiangnan, and Zhejiang—where li difference is especially pronounced—should receive daily observers so that local li differences and the sun's semidiameter may be established on solid evidence."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The order was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 五十八年二月，以推算人不敷用，敕禮部錄送蒙養齋考試，取傅明安等二十八人，命在修書處行走。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fifty-eighth year, because computational personnel were insufficient, an edict ordered the Ministry of Rites to send those who passed the Mengyang Studio examination, selecting Fu Ming'an and twenty-eight others, ordered to serve at the book-compilation office.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Kangxi 58, with too few calculators available, the Ministry of Rites was ordered to assign twenty-eight candidates including Fu Ming'an who had passed the Mengyang Studio examination to the compilation office.

sentences.zh: 六十年，御製算法書成，賜名數理精蘊。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year, the imperially composed book on computational methods was completed and granted the name Essence of Mathematical Principles.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 60 the emperor's work on mathematics was completed and titled Essence of Mathematical Principles.

sentences.zh: 諭：「此書賜梅文鼎一部，命悉心校對。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Give one copy of this book to Mei Wending and order him to collate it with full care."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered a copy sent to Mei Wending for careful collation.

sentences.zh: 」遣其孫梅瑴成齎書賜之。

translations.literal: " His grandson Mei Juecheng was sent to present the book as gift.
translations.idiomatic: Mei Juecheng was dispatched to deliver it.

sentences.zh: 六十一年六月，曆書稿成，並律呂、算法，共為律曆淵源一百卷：一曰曆象考成上、下編，一曰律呂精義上、下編，續編，一曰數理精蘊上、下編。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the sixty-first year, the calendrical books were completed, together with pitch pipes and computational methods, totaling one hundred volumes of Origins of Pitch and Calendar: first, Calendrical and Astronomical Investigations Completed, upper and lower parts; second, Essence of Pitch Pipes, upper and lower parts, continuation; third, Essence of Mathematical Principles, upper and lower parts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Kangxi 61 the calendrical manuscripts were finished, together with works on pitch pipes and mathematics, as the hundred-volume Origins of Pitch and Calendar: Calendrical and Astronomical Investigations Completed in two parts, Essence of Pitch Pipes in three parts, and Essence of Mathematical Principles in two parts.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，頒曆象考成於欽天監，是為康熙甲子元法。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng, Calendrical and Astronomical Investigations Completed was issued to the Directorate—this is the Kangxi jiazi-epoch method.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 Calendrical and Astronomical Investigations Completed was issued to the Directorate as the Kangxi jiazi-epoch system.

sentences.zh: 自雍正四年為始，造時憲書一遵曆象考成之法。

translations.literal: From the beginning of Yongzheng 4, the Shixian almanac was made entirely according to the methods of Calendrical and Astronomical Investigations Completed.
translations.idiomatic: From Yongzheng 4 onward the Shixian almanac followed that work exclusively.

sentences.zh: 又議準其御製之書，無庸欽天監治理，其治曆法之西洋人授為監正。

translations.literal: It was also approved that the emperor's own compositions need not be administered by the Directorate; Westerners skilled in calendrical methods were appointed Directors.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's own works were exempted from Directorate administration, and Western experts in astronomy were appointed directors.

sentences.zh: 八年六月，監正明安圖言：「日月行度，積久漸差，法須旋改，始能密合。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the eighth year, Director Ming Antu said: "The motions of sun and moon, through long accumulation gradually differ; methods must be revised in turn to achieve close agreement."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Yongzheng 8 Director Ming Antu reported: "Solar and lunar motions drift over time; the methods must be periodically revised to maintain precision."

sentences.zh: 臣等遵御製曆象考成推算時憲，據監正戴進賢、監副徐懋德推測，覺有微差。

translations.literal: Your servants follow the imperially composed Calendrical and Astronomical Investigations Completed to calculate the Shixian calendar; according to Director Dai Jinxian and Deputy Director Xu Maode's projections, we perceive slight discrepancies.
translations.idiomatic: We calculate the Shixian calendar by the imperial Calendrical and Astronomical Investigations Completed, but projections by Dai Jinxian and Xu Maode reveal slight discrepancies.

sentences.zh: 於本月初一日日食，臣等公同測驗，實測與推算分數不合，乞敕下戴進賢、徐懋德詳加校定修理。

translations.literal: On this month's first-day solar eclipse, we jointly tested; actual measurement and calculated magnitude did not agree—we beg that Dai Jinxian and Xu Maode be ordered to collate and repair in detail."
translations.idiomatic: At this month's solar eclipse our joint observations did not match the predictions; we ask that Dai Jinxian and Xu Maode undertake detailed revision."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The order was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 十年四月，修日躔、月離表成。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the tenth year, revision of the solar and lunar motion tables was completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Yongzheng 10 the solar and lunar motion tables were completed.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二年四月，協辦吏部尚書事顧琮言：「世宗皇帝允監臣言，請纂修日躔、月離二表，以推日月交合，並交宮過度，晦朔弦望，晝夜永短，以及淩犯，共三十九頁，續於曆象考成諸表之末。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year of Qianlong, Gu Cong, acting Minister of Personnel, said: "The Yongzheng Emperor approved the Directorate's request to compile solar and lunar motion tables for predicting eclipses, lodge passage, new and full moons, quarter moons, day and night length, and encroachments—thirty-nine pages in all, continued at the end of the tables in Calendrical and Astronomical Investigations Completed."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Qianlong 2 Gu Cong reported that the Yongzheng Emperor had ordered solar and lunar tables for eclipses, lodge passage, phases, day-length, and planetary conjunctions—thirty-nine pages appended to Calendrical and Astronomical Investigations Completed.

sentences.zh: 查造此表者，監正西洋人戴進賢；

translations.literal: The maker of these tables was the Western Director Dai Jinxian;
translations.idiomatic: Dai Jinxian, the Western director, had compiled them;

sentences.zh: 能用此表者，監副西洋人徐懋德與五官正明安圖。

translations.literal: those able to use them were the Western Deputy Director Xu Maode and Director of the Five Offices Ming Antu.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Maode, the Western deputy director, and Ming Antu of the Five Offices could use them.

sentences.zh: 擬令戴進賢為總裁，徐懋德、明安圖為副總裁，盡心考驗，增補圖說。

translations.literal: It is proposed that Dai Jinxian serve as chief compiler, Xu Maode and Ming Antu as deputy chief compilers, examining with full care and supplementing diagrams and explanations.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Jinxian was proposed as chief compiler with Xu Maode and Ming Antu as deputies to verify and supplement the diagrams.

sentences.zh: 曆象考成內倘有酌改之處，亦令其悉心改正。

translations.literal: Where Calendrical and Astronomical Investigations Completed needs revision, they are also to correct it with full care."
translations.idiomatic: They were also to revise the parent work wherever needed."

sentences.zh: 」敕：「即著顧琮專管。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Let Gu Cong take exclusive charge."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Gu Cong to take charge.

sentences.zh: 」五月，琮復言：「乞命梅瑴成為總裁，何國宗協同總裁。

translations.literal: " In the fifth month, Gu again said: "We beg that Mei Juecheng be chief compiler, He Guozong assisting as co-chief."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Gu proposed Mei Juecheng as chief compiler with He Guozong as co-chief.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The order was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 十一月，命莊親王允祿為總理。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Prince Zhuang Yunlu was appointed general supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Prince Zhuang Yunlu was appointed general supervisor.

sentences.zh: 三年四月，莊親王允祿等言：「曆象考成一書，其數惟黃赤大距減少二分，餘皆仍新法算書西人第穀之舊。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the third year, Prince Zhuang Yunlu and others said: "In Calendrical and Astronomical Investigations Completed, only the ecliptic-equatorial obliquity is reduced by two minutes; the rest still follows the old Western computational book of Tycho Brahe."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Qianlong 3 Prince Zhuang reported: "In Calendrical and Astronomical Investigations Completed only the ecliptic obliquity differs, reduced by two minutes; the rest still follows Tycho Brahe."

sentences.zh: 康熙中西人有噶西尼、法蘭德等，發第穀未盡之義，其大端有三：其一謂太陽地半徑差，舊定為三分，今測祗有十秒；

translations.literal: During Kangxi, Westerners such as Cassini and Flamsteed developed what Tycho had not fully explained; there are three main points: first, solar parallax was formerly fixed at three minutes, but now measurement shows only ten seconds;
translations.idiomatic: By Kangxi's reign Cassini and Flamsteed had advanced beyond Tycho on three points: solar parallax, formerly three minutes, is now measured at only ten seconds;

sentences.zh: 其一謂清蒙氣差，舊定地平上為三十四分，高四十五度，祗有五秒，今測地平上止三十二分，高四十五度，尚有五十九秒；

translations.literal: second, clear atmospheric refraction was formerly fixed at thirty-four minutes on the horizon and five seconds at forty-five degrees altitude, but now on the horizon only thirty-two minutes and at forty-five degrees still fifty-nine seconds;
translations.idiomatic: atmospheric refraction, formerly thirty-four minutes at the horizon and five seconds at forty-five degrees, is now thirty-two minutes at the horizon and fifty-nine seconds at forty-five degrees;

sentences.zh: 其一謂日月五星之本天非平圓，皆為橢圓，兩端徑長，兩腰徑短。

translations.literal: third, the primary heavens of sun, moon, and five planets are not perfect circles but ellipses, long at the ends and short at the sides.
translations.idiomatic: and the primary orbits of the sun, moon, and planets are elliptical, not circular.

sentences.zh: 以是三者，經緯度俱有微差。

translations.literal: Because of these three, longitude and latitude all have slight discrepancies.
translations.idiomatic: These three revisions produce slight changes in longitude and latitude.

sentences.zh: 戴進賢等習知其說，因未經徵驗，不敢遽以為是。

translations.literal: Dai Jinxian and others are versed in these theories, but because they have not been verified, dare not hastily affirm them.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Jinxian and his colleagues understood these theories but hesitated to adopt them without verification.

sentences.zh: 雍正八年六月朔日食，舊法推得九分二十二秒，今法推得八分十秒，驗諸實測，今法為近。

translations.literal: The solar eclipse on the new moon of the sixth month of Yongzheng 8: the old method predicted nine parts twenty-two seconds, the new method eight parts ten seconds; tested against observation, the new method is closer.
translations.idiomatic: The solar eclipse of Yongzheng 8, sixth month, sixth day: the old method predicted 9 parts 22 seconds, the new 8 parts 10 seconds; observation favored the new method.

sentences.zh: 故奏準重修日躔、月離新表二差，以續於曆象考成之後。

translations.literal: Therefore memorial approval was sought to revise the two differences in the new solar and lunar tables, continuing after Calendrical and Astronomical Investigations Completed.
translations.idiomatic: They therefore proposed revising the solar and lunar tables to continue Calendrical and Astronomical Investigations Completed.

sentences.zh: 臣等奉命增修表解圖說，以日躔新表推算，春分比前遲十三刻許，秋分比前早九刻許，冬夏至皆遲二刻許。

translations.literal: We were ordered to augment the tables, diagrams, and explanations; calculating by the new solar table, spring equinox is about thirteen quarters later than before, autumn equinox about nine quarters earlier, winter and summer solstices each about two quarters later.
translations.idiomatic: Ordered to expand the explanations, they found the new solar table placed spring equinox thirteen quarters later, autumn equinox nine quarters earlier, and both solstices two quarters later than before.

sentences.zh: 然以測午正日高，惟冬至比前高二分餘，夏至秋分僅差二三十秒。

translations.literal: Yet measuring noon sun altitude, only winter solstice is more than two minutes higher than before; summer solstice and autumn equinox differ by only twenty or thirty seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Noon altitude measurements showed only winter solstice more than two minutes higher; summer solstice and autumn equinox differed by mere seconds.

sentences.zh: 蓋測量在地面，而推算則以地心，今所定地半徑差與蒙氣差皆與前不同，故推算每差數刻，而測量終不甚相遠也。

translations.literal: Measurement is on the earth's surface, but calculation uses the earth's center; the earth-semidiameter and atmospheric corrections now differ from before, so calculation often differs by several quarters yet measurement is not very far apart.
translations.idiomatic: Because observation is from the surface but calculation from the earth's center, and parallax and refraction constants have changed, calculated times differ by quarters while measured altitudes scarcely change.

sentences.zh: 至其立法以本天為橢圓，雖推算較繁，而損益舊數以合天行，頗為新巧。

translations.literal: As for establishing the primary heaven as an ellipse—though calculation is more complex, adjusting old numbers to match celestial motion is rather ingeniously new.
translations.idiomatic: Modeling orbits as ellipses complicates calculation but adjusts constants more ingeniously to match the heavens.

sentences.zh: 臣等闡明理數，著日躔九篇並表數，乞親加裁定，附曆象考成之後，顏曰御製後編。

translations.literal: Your servants clarify principles and numbers, composing nine solar treatises with tables, begging imperial approval and appending after Calendrical and Astronomical Investigations Completed under the title Imperially Composed Sequel.
translations.idiomatic: They submitted nine treatises with tables as an Imperially Composed Sequel to Calendrical and Astronomical Investigations Completed.

sentences.zh: 凡前書已發明者，不復贅述。

translations.literal: What the former book already explained is not repeated.
translations.idiomatic: Points already covered in the earlier work were not repeated.

sentences.zh: 」報聞。

translations.literal: " Report received.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was noted.

sentences.zh: 七年，莊親王允祿等奏進日躔、月離、交宮共書十卷，是為雍正癸卯元法。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Prince Zhuang Yunlu and others presented ten volumes on solar motion, lunar motion, and lodge passage—this is the Yongzheng guimao-epoch method.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 7 Prince Zhuang submitted ten volumes on solar motion, lunar motion, and lodge passage—the Yongzheng guimao-epoch system.

sentences.zh: 九年十月，監正戴進賢等言：「靈台儀象誌原載星辰約七十年差一度，為時已久，宜改定。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the ninth year, Director Dai Jinxian and others said: "The Observatory Treatise on Instruments states fixed stars shift about one degree in seventy years; time has been long and revision is fitting."
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Qianlong 9 Dai Jinxian reported that the seventy-year precession rate in the Observatory Treatise needed revision.

sentences.zh: 康熙十三年修誌之時，黃赤大距與今測不同，所列諸表，當逐一增修。

translations.literal: When the treatise was compiled in Kangxi 13, ecliptic-equatorial obliquity differed from present measurement; the tables listed should be revised one by one.
translations.idiomatic: The ecliptic obliquity at compilation in Kangxi 13 differed from current measurement; all tables required revision.

sentences.zh: 三垣二十八宿以及諸星，今昔多寡不同，亦應釐訂。

translations.literal: The Three Enclosures, twenty-eight lodges, and other stars now differ in number from then and should also be corrected.
translations.idiomatic: The star catalogs for the Three Enclosures and twenty-eight lodges also needed updating.

sentences.zh: 」敕莊親王、鄂爾泰、張照議奏。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered Prince Zhuang, Ortai, and Zhang Zhao to deliberate and memorialize.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zhuang, Ortai, and Zhang Zhao were ordered to deliberate.

sentences.zh: 十一月，議準仍以三人兼管。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, approval was given that the three men continue joint supervision.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the three were confirmed as supervisors.

sentences.zh: 是年更定羅睺、計都名目，又增入紫炁為四餘。

translations.literal: That year the names of Rahu and Ketu were revised, and Ziqi was again added to make four residuals.
translations.idiomatic: That year Rahu and Ketu were renamed and Ziqi restored as a fourth residual.

sentences.zh: 十七年，莊親王允祿等言儀象誌所載之星，多不順序，今依次改正，共成書三十卷，賜名儀象考成。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, Prince Zhuang Yunlu and others said stars in the Instruments Treatise were mostly out of order; now corrected in sequence, thirty volumes completed, granted the name Instruments Investigations Completed.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 17 Prince Zhuang reported that stars in the Instruments Treatise were reordered into thirty volumes titled Instruments Investigations Completed.

sentences.zh: 是月莊親王等復奏改正恒星經緯度表，並更定二十八宿值日觜參之前後。

translations.literal: That month Prince Zhuang and others again memorialized revision of the fixed-star longitude-latitude table and reordering of the twenty-eight lodges' duty days, placing Zi before Shen.
translations.idiomatic: That month they also revised the fixed-star table and lodge duty-day order, placing Zi before Shen.

sentences.zh: 敕大學士會同九卿議奏。

translations.literal: An edict ordered grand secretaries together with the Nine Chief Ministers to deliberate and memorialize.
translations.idiomatic: Grand secretaries and the Nine Chief Ministers were ordered to deliberate.

sentences.zh: 十二月，大學士傅恒等言：「請以乾隆十九年為始，時憲書之值宿，改觜前參後。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Grand Secretary Fu Heng and others said: "We request that from Qianlong 19 the almanac's duty lodges change to Zi before Shen."
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Fu Heng proposed adopting Zi-before-Shen lodge order from Qianlong 19.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The order was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 既而欽天監又以推算土星有差減平行三十分，自乾隆以後至道光初，交食分秒漸與原推不合。

translations.literal: Subsequently the Directorate also reduced Saturn's mean motion by thirty minutes because of calculation discrepancies; from Qianlong onward until early Daoguang, eclipse minutes and seconds gradually failed to match original predictions.
translations.idiomatic: Later Saturn's mean motion was reduced thirty minutes for discrepancies; from Qianlong to early Daoguang eclipse predictions gradually drifted.

sentences.zh: 道光十八年八月，管理欽天監事務工部尚書敬徵言：「自道光四年臣管理監務，查觀象台儀器，康熙十三年所製黃赤大距，皆為二十三度三十二分。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the eighteenth year of Daoguang, Jing Zheng, Minister of Works managing Directorate affairs, said: "Since I took charge in Daoguang 4, examining Observatory instruments, the ecliptic-equatorial obliquity made in Kangxi 13 was all 23 degrees 32 minutes."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Daoguang 18 Jing Zheng, overseeing the Directorate, reported that instruments from Kangxi 13 still showed an obliquity of 23°32′.

sentences.zh: 至乾隆九年重製璣衡撫辰儀，所測黃赤大距，則為二十三度二十九分，是原設諸儀已與天行不合，今又將百年，即撫辰儀亦有差失。

translations.literal: When the Jiyun Armillary was remade in Qianlong 9, measured obliquity was 23 degrees 29 minutes—the original instruments no longer matched celestial motion; now nearly another century, even the Jiyun instrument has error.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiyun armillary remade in Qianlong 9 measured 23°29′, proving the old instruments obsolete; after another century even the Jiyun instrument had drifted.

sentences.zh: 臣將撫辰儀更換軸心，諸儀亦量為安置。

translations.literal: Your servant replaced the Jiyun instrument's axis and adjusted other instruments as needed.
translations.idiomatic: Jing replaced the Jiyun armillary's axis and adjusted the other instruments.

sentences.zh: 另製小象限儀一，令官生晝測日行，夜測月星，每逢節氣交食，所測實數有與推算不合者，詳加考驗。

translations.literal: A small quadrant was also made, ordering students to measure the sun by day and moon and stars by night; whenever solar terms or eclipses occurred, if actual numbers disagreed with calculation, detailed verification was applied.
translations.idiomatic: A small quadrant was added for daily solar and nightly lunar and stellar observation, with verification whenever predictions failed.

sentences.zh: 知由太陽緯度不合之數，測得黃赤大距較前稍小，其數僅二十三度二十七分。

translations.literal: Knowing from the sun's latitude discrepancy, measured ecliptic-equatorial obliquity is somewhat smaller than before, the number being only 23 degrees 27 minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Solar latitude discrepancies indicated an obliquity of only 23°27′.

sentences.zh: 由交節時刻之早晚，考知太陽行度有進退不齊之分。

translations.literal: From the earliness or lateness of nodal times, it was known the sun's motion has uneven advance and retreat.
translations.idiomatic: Nodal timing showed uneven solar motion.

sentences.zh: 夫太陽行度為推測之本，諸曜宗之。

translations.literal: The sun's motion is the foundation of all calculation; the luminaries take it as their model.
translations.idiomatic: Solar motion is the foundation of all astronomical calculation.

sentences.zh: 而推日行，又以歲實、氣應兩心差曰本天最卑行度為據。

translations.literal: To project the sun's daily motion, the tropical year and the two-center difference called the primary heaven's perigee motion serve as basis.
translations.idiomatic: Solar motion depends on the tropical year and the perigee motion of the primary orbit.

sentences.zh: 擬自道光十四年甲午為年根，按實測之數，將原用數稍為損益，推得日行交節時刻，似與實測之數較近。

translations.literal: Proposed from Daoguang 14 jiawu as year-root, adjusting original constants slightly according to observed numbers, projected nodal times seem closer to observation.
translations.idiomatic: Taking Daoguang 14 jiawu as epoch and adjusting constants to observation, nodal times improved.

sentences.zh: 至太陰行度，以交食為考驗之大端。

translations.literal: Lunar motion is tested chiefly by eclipses.
translations.idiomatic: Lunar motion is verified chiefly through eclipses.

sentences.zh: 近年測過之月食，較原推早者多，遲者少。

translations.literal: Recent lunar eclipses mostly came earlier than predicted, rarely later.
translations.idiomatic: Recent lunar eclipses had mostly occurred earlier than predicted.

sentences.zh: 故於月之平行、自行、交行內量為損益，按現擬之平行，仍用諸均之舊數，推得道光十四年後月食三次。

translations.literal: Therefore within the moon's mean, true, and node motions adjustments were made; using the proposed mean with old mean numbers, three lunar eclipses after Daoguang 14 were projected.
translations.idiomatic: Lunar mean, true, and node motions were adjusted accordingly, and three post-Daoguang 14 eclipses were projected.

sentences.zh: 除十七年三月祗見初虧，九月天陰未測，僅測得道光十六年九月十五日月食，與新數所推相近，然僅食一次，尚未可憑，仍須隨時考驗。

translations.literal: Except the third month of the seventeenth year showed only first contact, and September was cloudy and untested, only the lunar eclipse of the fifteenth day of the ninth month of Daoguang 16 was measured, close to the new numbers—but one eclipse is not yet reliable and testing must continue.
translations.idiomatic: Only the eclipse of Daoguang 16, ninth month, fifteenth day, had been fully observed and matched the new constants; one case was insufficient, and further testing was required.

sentences.zh: 現屆本年八月十五日月食，謹將新擬用數推算得時刻食分方位，比較原推早見分秒，另繕清單進呈。

translations.literal: The lunar eclipse on the fifteenth day of the eighth month of this year is at hand; we respectfully calculate times, magnitude, and orientation by the new constants, earlier in minutes and seconds than the old projection, and submit a separate clear list.
translations.idiomatic: For the upcoming eighth-month eclipse they submitted predictions by the new constants, earlier than the old method.

sentences.zh: 至期臣等逐時測驗，再行據實具奏。

translations.literal: When the day comes your servants will test hour by hour and report truthfully."
translations.idiomatic: They would observe and report when the day arrived."

sentences.zh: 」報聞。

translations.literal: " Report received.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was noted.

sentences.zh: 二十二年六月，敬徵等又言：「每屆日月交食，按新擬用數推算，俱與實測相近。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twenty-second year, Jing Zheng and others again said: "Whenever solar and lunar eclipses occur, calculation by the new constants all closely match observation."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Daoguang 22 Jing Zheng reported that recent eclipses calculated by the new constants had matched observation.

sentences.zh: 至本年六月朔日食，新推較之實測，僅差數秒。

translations.literal: For this year's new-moon solar eclipse, the new projection compared with observation differed by only a few seconds.
translations.idiomatic: The current year's solar eclipse differed from observation by only seconds.

sentences.zh: 是新擬之數，於日行已無疑義，月行亦屬近合。

translations.literal: Thus the new constants for solar motion are beyond doubt, and lunar motion is also nearly in agreement.
translations.idiomatic: Solar motion was now reliable; lunar motion was nearly so.

sentences.zh: 今擬先測恒星，以符運度，繼考日躔、月離，務合天行。

translations.literal: Now we propose first measuring fixed stars to match their motion, then examining solar and lunar motion to accord with the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: They proposed measuring fixed stars first, then revising solar and lunar motion.

sentences.zh: 請以道光十四年甲午為元，按新數日行黃赤大距，修恒星、黃赤道經緯度表，即於測算時詳考五緯月行，俾恒星、五緯、日月交食等書，得以次第竣事。

translations.literal: We beg to take Daoguang 14 jiawu as epoch, revise fixed-star and ecliptic-equatorial tables by the new solar obliquity, and during calculation examine the five planets and moon in detail, so books on fixed stars, five planets, and eclipses may be completed in order."
translations.idiomatic: Taking Daoguang 14 jiawu as epoch, they sought to revise star tables and complete works on the planets, moon, and eclipses."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The order was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 是年七月，以敬徵為修曆總裁，監正周餘慶、左監副高煜為副總裁。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of that year, Jing Zheng was appointed chief compiler of the calendar revision, Director Zhou Yuqing and Left Deputy Director Gao Yu as deputy chief compilers.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Jing Zheng became chief compiler with Zhou Yuqing and Gao Yu as deputies.

sentences.zh: 二十五年七月，進呈黃道經緯度表、赤道經緯度表各十三卷，月五星相距表一卷，天漢界度表四卷，經星彙考、星首步天歌、恒星總紀各一卷，為儀象考成續編。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the twenty-fifth year, ecliptic longitude-latitude tables and equatorial longitude-latitude tables of thirteen volumes each, one volume of lunar-five-planet distance table, four volumes of Milky Way boundary table, and one volume each of Fixed Star Compendium, Star-Rhyme Steps Through Heaven, and Fixed Star General Record were presented—as the sequel to Instruments Investigations Completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Daoguang 25 they submitted star tables and related works as the sequel to Instruments Investigations Completed.

sentences.zh: 至日月交食、五星行度俱闕而未備雲。

translations.literal: Solar and lunar eclipses and five-planet motions were all lacking and not yet complete.
translations.idiomatic: Works on eclipses and planetary motion remained incomplete.

sentences.zh: 時冬官正司廷棟撰淩犯視差新法，用弧三角布算，以限距地高及星距黃極以求黃經高弧三角，較舊法為簡捷。

translations.literal: At this time Winter Offices Director Si Tingdong composed New Methods for Encroachment Parallax, using spherical triangles for calculation, obtaining ecliptic longitude high spherical triangles from limit, distance from earth, and star distance from ecliptic pole—simpler and quicker than the old method.
translations.idiomatic: Si Tingdong of the Winter Offices devised a spherical-triangle method for encroachment parallax, simpler than the old approach.

sentences.zh: 乾隆以後，曆官能損益舊法，廷棟一人而已。

translations.literal: After Qianlong, among calendar officials able to adjust old methods, only Tingdong.
translations.idiomatic: After Qianlong, only Si Tingdong among official astronomers could improve the methods.

sentences.zh: 其不為曆官而知曆者，梅文鼎、薛鳳祚、王錫闡以下，江永、戴震、錢大昕、李善蘭為尤著。

translations.literal: Those knowing calendrical science without being calendar officials—after Mei Wending, Xue Fengzuo, and Wang Xichan, Jiang Yong, Dai Zhen, Qian Daxin, and Li Shanlan are especially renowned.
translations.idiomatic: Outside official circles, Mei Wending, Xue Fengzuo, Wang Xichan, and later Jiang Yong, Dai Zhen, Qian Daxin, and Li Shanlan were especially distinguished.

sentences.zh: 其闡明中、西曆理，實遠出徐光啟、李之藻等之上焉。

translations.literal: In clarifying Chinese and Western calendrical principles, they truly far surpass Xu Guangqi, Li Zhizao, and others.
translations.idiomatic: In explaining the principles of Chinese and Western astronomy, they far surpassed Xu Guangqi and Li Zhizao.
